plain: A huge number of things; the word first meant ten thousand.

example.quote: Numerous states yet unformed, myriads of the human race, who will inhabit regions hitherto uncultivated, were to be affected by the result of their proceedings.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, November 26, 1787 (2d ed. 1836)
